text: E ɓee sirkooɓe ndaaraali colli ɗin no eltiraa wiiru-gol non ka weeyo sabu ko Alla yeɗiri kon gabbitti e henndu newiindu? O anndini ɗi fontugol accita gabitti(bibje) ɗin? Jogitaaki ɗi haɗiɗi yanugol e ndun henndu si wanaa Alla hattanɗo On. Wonii e ngol eltugol jogitoo ɗin colli wata ɗi yanu, hujjaaji wonannde yimɓe gomɗinooɓe Alla ɓen, tawde ko kamɓe nafitorta hujjaaji ɗin ɓe waajitora.
